entries.claim: README still says "The spine's confirm question names the command", but after 4482e4c SKILL.md section 17 has the command in a separate sentence before a plain question that doesn't name it, so the user-facing doc now describes the old one-question form.
entries.failure_scenario: A user reads README line 61 and expects `/seldon architecture` in the confirm question. Every phase-9 trace ends instead with "`/seldon architecture` can write the full architecture document once you confirm. Do you confirm the spine, or do you want changes?" There, the question itself ("Do you confirm the spine, or do you want changes?") never names the command. PLAN-3 put the README out of scope, so nothing in this plan fixes the drift.
